{{Quote|You don't have a problem dealing with Gungans, do you? Personally I can't understand a blasted thing they say, but the boss has a soft spot for them. One of them, named Mubarr, owes us a little money and hasn't been coming around to make his payments. Would you mind collecting for us?|[[Bardo Klinj]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BK" />}}
'''Mubarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Gungan was indebted to the [[Hutt/Legends|the Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]].<ref name="SWG:BK" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] working for [[Bardo Klinj]], one of Borvo's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], sliced Mubarr's bank records and discovered that the Gungan had enough money to pay the Hutt. However, Mubarr still refused to reimburse what he owned to Borvo. Bardo Klinj thus tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to meet Mubarr near the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] and enforce the Gungan to give the codes of his bank account.<ref name="SWG:BK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mubarr was intended to appear as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mubarr should have appeared in the third quest given by Bardo Klinj on Naboo. However, the quest was bugged and Mubarr did not spawn in the game. It was therefore impossible to complete Bardo Klinj's questline.<ref name="SWG:BK" /><ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=game_guides&message.id=148427|text=Quests NPC all around SWG World - March 2004}}</ref><ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=76216.html|text=Has Anyone Completed All the Working Static Quests?}} {{C|"username/password: swganh"}}</ref>
